description: This file defines the SNProtocolOperator004 class, implementing encryption and decryption operations using the XChaCha20-Poly1305 algorithm, including key generation, payload encryption/decryption, and root key derivation for version 004 protocol.

classes.name: SNProtocolOperator004
classes.description: Implements encryption/decryption operations for protocol version 004, including key management, payload encryption, and decryption, using the XChaCha20-Poly1305 algorithm.

methods.name: getEncryptionDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the encryption algorithm used.

methods.name: createItemsKey
methods.description: Creates a new items encryption key.

methods.name: generateSalt004
methods.description: Generates a salt for key derivation based on identifier and seed.

methods.name: computeRootKey
methods.description: Derives a root key from a password and key parameters.

methods.name: createRootKey
methods.description: Creates a new root key based on identifier, password, and origination.

methods.name: encryptString004
methods.description: Encrypts a string using XChaCha20-Poly1305 with authenticated data.

methods.name: decryptString004
methods.description: Decrypts a string encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305.

methods.name: generateEncryptionNonce
methods.description: Generates a random nonce for encryption.

methods.name: generateEncryptedProtocolString
methods.description: Creates an encrypted payload string with version, nonce, ciphertext, and authenticated data.

methods.name: deconstructEncryptedPayloadString
methods.description: Splits an encrypted payload string into its components.

methods.name: getPayloadAuthenticatedData
methods.description: Extracts authenticated data from an encrypted payload.

methods.name: generateAuthenticatedDataForPayload
methods.description: Generates authenticated data for a payload, including key parameters if applicable.

methods.name: authenticatedDataToString
methods.description: Converts authenticated data to a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: stringToAuthenticatedData
methods.description: Parses a base64-encoded string into authenticated data object.

methods.name: generateEncryptedParametersSync
methods.description: Encrypts a payload synchronously, returning encrypted parameters.

methods.name: generateDecryptedParametersSync
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted parameters synchronously, returning the original payload or error.

methods.name: deriveKey
methods.description: Derives a root key from password and key parameters using Argon2.
